card.title: Calm About the Impossible
card.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.

mechanism: A accepts levitating furniture while escalating alarm about ordinary cup stains and footwear damage.
confusable: Unlike fear of the impossible event, A's urgency must stay attached to everyday surface care.
comparison: Footwear and polish during packing differ from the dragon host's napkin hierarchy.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
